Class ClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.ClientHandler
public class ClientHandler extends Object
The ClientHandler class manages client connections, communication, and server-side operations. It handles incoming and outgoing messages, maintains client states, and provides methods for broadcasting and processing commands.

  • Method Details

    • putFileInTheOutGoingFileQueue

      public void putFileInTheOutGoingFileQueue(Command command, int clientId)
      This method is called by serverserializer to put files in the outGoingFileQueue specific to the client with id=clientid. It is executed by an executor for each client. It takes the file from the queue and sends it to the client. The method put() is blocking, so it blocks until there is space in the queue to put the file.
      Parameters:
      command - The file that has to be put in the outGoingFileQueue.
      clientId - The int corresponding to the specific client
